chapters.reason: The paper explicitly focuses on converting pretrained Transformer models into linearized versions using attention transfer and low-rank adaptation, which is the definition of training-induced hidden-state conversion.
The goal of the conversion is to replace quadratic attention with subquadratic linear attention mechanisms, which fall under the category of linear-state recurrence.
The method uses a specific two-step training strategy (attention transfer followed by LoRA) to optimize the linearized model, aligning with training strategies for recurrent reasoning/conversion.
